For the Petitioner: Mrs. Vani Kumari, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Shashi Kumar Verma, A.P.P.
---
04 / 04.08.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Mahagama P.S. Case No. 02 of 2022 for the offences registered under sections 304B/498A/120B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Satish Kumar Munda, learned Judicial Magistrate, Godda.
3. Petitioner happens to be the husband of the deceased Kiran Kumari who died due to poisoning in her matrimonial home.
4. It was submitted that earlier, unnatural death was reported and thereafter complaint was filed alleging therein that the petitioner had poisoned the deceased to enforce the demand of dowry.
5. Viscera Report earlier called for, has been received.
It appears that no poison was found in the viscera of the deceased.
6. In view of the submission made above, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Satish Kumar Munda, learned Judicial Magistrate, Godda in connection with Bablu Kujur vs The State Of Jharkhand --- --- Opp. Party on 4 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135465858/
1 Mahagama P.S. Case No. 02 of 2022.
